components.explanation: assets/models/archer_piece.glb: the unit, 0.40 x 0.80 x 0.40 m in Godot (Blender 0.40 x 0.40 x 0.80), 254 triangles, 5 flat materials, origin at the base; built by Claude through the MCP (tools/blender/build_archer_piece.py, B03), with Jiean's hand edit moving the bow +0.08 m in Y (B04-B05), exported headless with +Y up. The .import sidecar holds Godot's import settings (generate_lods=true, not examined by the check). Seen in Godot in B02, B08, B09.

assets/models/board_square.glb: one tile of the five-lane board, 1.00 x 0.05 x 1.00 m, 60 triangles, slab #D8C7A0 and border #9A7F55 (revision A3-R1, chosen by Jiean, B10). Seen in Godot in B02, B08 and from above in B11.

assets/models/goal_flag.glb: marks the enemy back row, 0.45 x 1.20 x 0.30 m, 84 triangles, walnut base and pole, enemy-red cloth only 0.02 m thick, so it is edge-on from +/-X (Claude's report in the student's recording, B06; seen in the orbit, B08).

diorama/asset_diorama.tscn, written by hand by Claude: a 5 x 3 m floor at y = 0 in the table colour, one DirectionalLight3D with shadows, a WorldEnvironment, a Camera3D at (0, 1.1, 3), and the three .glb scenes instanced at x = -1.2, 0 and 1.1 with y = 0 (B07). project.godot sets the Compatibility renderer used for the capture. Shown running in B08-B09 and B11 (capture run-02).

tests/check_assets.gd measures each .glb alone (AABB, height axis, lowest y, node scale/rotation, triangles, albedo colours) and then the diorama (gap to the Floor mesh's top, camera frustum, overlap), writing a JSON report through tests/test_report.gd. Lines 171-182 (B12) hold the fix: wait one frame and refuse to measure outside the tree. Results: run 1 32/33 (faulty), run 2 38/38, film rerun 38/38 (B13). Headless uses a dummy renderer: nothing about looks is tested.

var scene: Node3D = packed.instantiate() as Node3D
	root.add_child(scene)
	await process_frame
	if not rep.check("diorama: scene is inside the tree before measuring", scene.is_inside_tree()):
		return

	var floor_node: MeshInstance3D = scene.get_node("Floor") as MeshInstance3D
	var floor_box: AABB = floor_node.global_transform * floor_node.get_aabb()
	var floor_top: float = floor_box.end.y
	var cam: Camera3D = scene.get_node("Camera3D") as Camera3D
	rep.check("diorama: camera has a real frustum (6 planes), so the view check can mean something",
		cam.get_frustum().size() == 6, "%d planes" % cam.get_frustum().size())
